start: A throwaway board seeded with one card of each kind and no tickets, then T-9, T-29 (under T-9), T-30, held T-31 and T-32, and lifecycle T-33, a card of each kind posted with --ticket T-29, and an ask naming T-404.
steps: Open the Tickets tab and a ticket on a phone and at 1280 px, in light and dark; inspect the board-wide and per-ticket Activity feeds.
Answer a linked ask on held T-32 and verify it releases to To do with a Hold released event; reply to a comment on held T-31 and verify it releases.
Open each linked card (an ask, an update, a design review, a guided report, a guided plan), the same kind with no ticket, and the ask naming T-404.
Answer an ask No with a note, change it to Yes with a note, let its agent take it, ask for a new round; give the update Pass with a note and a comment.
Open each card's Activity, tap the ask's Its ask row to open T-29, read its Linked list and Activity, close it, then open T-9.
result: Each linked card shows a Ticket row with the ticket title, T-29 and 60% that opens the ticket; unlinked cards and the T-404 ask show none; held T-32 releases after its linked ask is answered, held T-31 releases after its comment is answered, and both release events appear in Activity; board and per-ticket feeds show lifecycle events newest first; the ticket lists its six cards newest first, in progress at 60%, with card activity newest first; T-9 lists its two tickets at 80%; each card lists its answers, notes, pickup and new round oldest first.
